remaining.title: Chromium verification runs with --no-sandbox and is not bound to canonical browser-game worker sandbox policy
Native deployed ESM origin/module-loader path remains unverified
Sanitized asset filenames can collide and silently overwrite distinct assets
build-manifest.json is written after artifact enumeration and is not covered by RuntimePackageManifest
Build subprocesses inherit ambient environment and lack CPU/memory/process-count confinement
Audio cues/assets are manifest-only; live runtime playback/sync/ducking path is absent
Accessibility validation is contract-level, not full runtime interaction accessibility
Runtime language is hard-coded to English and GAME contracts lack locale/RTL/multilingual text policy
No runtime performance, responsive layout or mobile interaction budgets/tests
GAME artifacts/runs are not integrated with canonical ArtifactEnvelope/CAS/idempotency/durable execution
Telemetry compiler sanitizes data but live runtime emits no governed telemetry events
Mastery/scoring/adaptation do not form a persistent closed learning loop
Consolidated ORIGINAL omits BIE-GAME-DSL-001 own test/spec/task-result payload
New modular GAME DSL has no explicit compatibility shim for current canonical bie.game_engine.contracts legacy API
COMP-002 is React-shaped but Build runtime uses a custom DOM createElement shim instead of an actual React/ReactDOM runtime
Inherited dynamic __import__(json) remains in browser runtime
No property-based/fuzz testing for codec/expression/path/input state spaces
